Author: Basil
Name: XIVPerf
Description:
Applies targeted native engine patches to remove CPU hot spots in crowded cities:
- Havok bone child table (replaces O(N^2) scans in hkaPose::accessBoneModelSpace)
- Kernel::Notifier skip list (keeps idle GPU resources off the per-frame walk)
- TempAllocator fast slab cache (per-thread magazines eliminating the 15-thread RenderView lock convoy)

Each patch can be toggled independently in /xivperf.
Changelog: Initial release with Havok child table, Kernel::Notifier skip list, and TempAllocator fast slab cache (native v4).
